name: cizle
tagline: Video and image prompts, and skills for Claude Code
title: cizle: video prompts, image prompts and Claude Code skills, in many languages
description: A free library of video prompts, image prompts and Claude Code skills from creators around the world, in many languages. Every prompt credits its creator: video prompts play their demo and image prompts show their pictures. Copy a prompt or install a skill and make it yours.
